Hello, my lovely viewers at home.
It has truly been a long time.
I have missed you so much,
and I hope you missed us as
well.
I am thrilled to tell you we
are back.
We are back, like we never left.
I welcome you to another episode
of Unmuted Podcast.
Every week, we will
dive into deep, raw
and authentic conversations
with community arts leaders and members.
Uncovering their untold stories,
layer by layer, truth by truth.
Are you ready? Fasten your seatbelts.
I am your host.
Today is truly a special one,
I am sitting across from a sensational
guest.
Welcome to our studio.
Thank you. My name is Siphamandla.
I live in Harare, Khayelitsha.
I am happy to be here.
First and foremost, thank you so much.
thank you for accepting our invitation.
It means a lot to us.
Let us get into it.
I want you to take us back.
Many people know you as a comedian,
someone who always makes us laugh.
I want us to go deeper.
Can you please tell us
where you were born and raised?
What was your childhood like?
I was born here in Cape Town.
Then I moved to Durban at two
months old,
with my grandmother.
I was a church-going child.
I loved my friends and playing,
like every other child.
I grew up well.
Everything was going well.
I love that!
You are a singer — a great
one!
On that note,
I want you
to take us back…
